data.name: Status_Starting
data.value: Starting… checking the network for another DHCP server

data.name: Notice_PoolExhausted
data.value: No free addresses left: a device asked for an address and got none.

data.name: Notice_LeaseFileNotWritable
data.value: The lease file cannot be saved next to the program; leases will be lost when you close it.

data.name: Notice_FirewallHint
data.value: No requests received yet. If a device is connected, allow DhcpServer in Windows Firewall (including for public networks).

data.name: Reason_Down
data.value: The interface is disconnected or turned off.

data.name: Reason_NotSupportedType
data.value: Only Ethernet and Wi-Fi interfaces can be used.

data.name: Reason_NoIpv4Address
data.value: The interface has no IPv4 address. Give it a fixed address first.

data.name: Reason_LinkLocalAddress
data.value: The interface only has an automatic (169.254.x.x) address. Give it a fixed address first.

data.name: Reason_SubnetTooSmall
data.value: The interface's subnet size is not supported (use a mask between /8 and /30).

data.name: Reason_SubnetOverlap
data.value: The interface's subnet overlaps with another active network connection.

data.name: Reason_OtherDhcpServer
data.value: Another DHCP server answered on this network ({0}). Starting a second one could break the network.

data.name: Reason_ProbeInconclusive
data.value: Could not check whether another DHCP server is present, so the server was not started.

data.name: Reason_PortInUse
data.value: The DHCP port (UDP 67) is already used by another program.

data.name: Reason_AccessDenied
data.value: Access to the DHCP port was denied. Run the program as administrator.

data.name: Reason_InterfaceLost
data.value: The interface was disconnected or changed, so the server stopped.

data.name: Leases_Empty
data.value: No devices yet. Connect a device and start the server.

data.name: Address_UseFixed
data.value: Set a fixed address for this session

data.name: Field_Malformed
data.value: This is not a valid IPv4 address.

data.name: Field_NotUnicast
data.value: Use a normal host address (not 0.x.x.x, 127.x.x.x, multicast or broadcast).

data.name: Field_MaskInvalid
data.value: This is not a valid subnet mask.

data.name: Field_MaskSize
data.value: The mask must be between 255.0.0.0 (/8) and 255.255.255.252 (/30).

data.name: Field_NetworkOrBroadcast
data.value: This is the network or broadcast address of the subnet; choose a host address.

data.name: Field_GatewayOutsideSubnet
data.value: The gateway must be a different host address inside the same subnet.

data.name: Field_DnsDuplicate
data.value: The two DNS servers are the same.

data.name: Field_SubnetOverlap
data.value: This subnet overlaps another active network connection.

data.name: Confirm_Intro
data.value: The program will change the network settings of {0} for this session:

data.name: Confirm_RestoreNote
data.value: The previous settings are restored when you stop the server or close the program.

data.name: Notice_SettingsApplied
data.value: The address was set for this session.

data.name: Recovery_Pending
data.value: The network settings of {0} were not restored after the previous session. They should be: {1}

data.name: Recovery_DiscardConfirm
data.value: Discard the saved settings? This program will no longer restore the previous network settings.

data.name: Recovery_Corrupt
data.value: The saved network settings cannot be read, so they cannot be restored. You can discard them.

data.name: Notice_SettingsRestored
data.value: The previous network settings were restored.

data.name: Notice_SettingsLeftUnchanged
data.value: The network settings were changed by someone else during the session, so they were left as they are.

data.name: Notice_AdapterMissing
data.value: The adapter is not available, so its settings could not be restored. They will be restored the next time the program starts with the adapter present.

data.name: Reason_AddressApplyFailed
data.value: Changing the network settings failed at step: {0}. The previous settings were put back.

data.name: Reason_AddressRestoreFailed
data.value: Restoring the network settings failed at step: {0}. They should be: {1}

data.name: Reason_SettingsLocked
data.value: Another instance of the program is changing the network settings, or an earlier session still has to be restored.

data.name: Reason_RecordNotWritable
data.value: The program cannot save the information needed to restore the old settings next to itself, so nothing was changed. Run it from a writable folder.

data.name: Reason_AddressNotReady
data.value: The new address did not become usable in time. The previous settings were put back.

data.name: Step_WaitForAddress
data.value: waiting for the address to become usable
